answer: Because the timing is recorded against the pearl challenge, the crystal audit can replay the vertex history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 93 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A farm of 906 identities would post 3326 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
